art_direction: 浅鼠尾草底，左眼高而更眯，右眼半开，困意中向左游移。
composition_variation: Place the left eye a little higher but much more covered by its lid, while the right remains a soft half-open bowl. Both broad black pupils drift together left, leaving color mainly at the outer sides. Curve the lid ends downward slightly without using rigid horizontal bars. Attention seems to be slowly drifting away. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
